title: Crew Attendance Standard: Access, Distance and Stairs on a Northbeam Delivery
content:
This standard states the conditions under which a crew attends an address on an order under
Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment.

**Access.** The customer is told what the fulfilment service's access requirements are before the slot is set.

**Distance.** A delivery beyond the fulfilment service's radius carries that service's out of radius surcharge; a
delivery to an address within that radius carries no such surcharge.

**Stairs.** Stairs above the first flight carry the service's surcharge for each further flight. The first flight
carries no such surcharge.

**Crew.** A crew of two attends where the fulfilment service requires it.

## The same four conditions as a table

| Condition at the address | What the standard provides |
| --- | --- |
| The access the service requires | told to the customer before the slot is set |
| An address inside the service's radius | no out of radius surcharge |
| An address beyond the service's radius | the service's out of radius surcharge |
| One flight of stairs | no stairs surcharge |
| Each flight of stairs above the first | the service's stairs surcharge for that flight |
| A service that requires two people | a crew of two attends |

## Counting the flights (hypothetical flights)

Because the surcharge attaches to each flight above the first, an address reached by one flight carries none, an
address reached by two flights carries the service's stairs surcharge once, and an address reached by four flights
carries it three times.
